create_Hooks: create a Hooks dataclass instance with optional guard_export_fn and guard_fail_fn callbacks
build_Hooks_callbacks: build a Hooks dataclass with a guard_export_fn callback that receives a GuardsSet
test_Hooks_default: test the Hooks dataclass with both guard_export_fn and guard_fail_fn set to None
refactor_Hooks_callbacks: refactor a Hooks dataclass to pass callable guard fail handlers that receive GuardFail objects
summarize_Hooks: summarize the Hooks dataclass used for dynamo guard export and guard fail callbacks
